audio.title: Audio Studio
audio.script_placeholder: Paste your dialogue. Example: Speaker 1: Good morning...
audio.tags_english_note: Tags stay in English, even for French scripts (per Google guidance).
audio.empty_script: No script yet. Load an example:
audio.too_many_speakers: Two voices maximum in this version.
audio.preview_empty: Speaker turns and audio tags will appear here.
audio.quota_blocked: Not enough quota for this estimate.
audio.prepare_empty_hint: Paste your script first — Audio Studio prepares it, it doesn't write it.
audio.prepare_review_hint: Choose the edits to apply. The script stays intact until you confirm.
audio.help_intro: Everything you need for a good take: writing the script, directing the voice, and generating without wasting your quota.
audio.help_speakers: In dialogue, start every line with Speaker 1: or Speaker 2:. Real names stay out of the script sent to the model.
audio.help_tags: Place bracketed tags ideally at the start of a line or sentence. The list below shows proven examples, but other tags (e.g. [confused], [laughing softly]) are accepted too.
audio.help_stage: Avoid stage directions in the script. Prepare for audio converts them, moves them to Direction, or removes them.
audio.help_direction: Put setting, character state, and non-spoken actions in Direction, not in the text to read.
audio.help_dictation: Timed-pause dictation arrives in a future version. In the meantime, insert manual [pause] tags where needed.
audio.console_failed_hint: This take failed - trying again costs you nothing.
audio.player_block_hint: Click a waveform block to regenerate only that part.
audio.param_help_level: Only changes the delivery: speed, pauses, articulation (A1 very slow and crisp, C1 authentic pace with linking). Never rewrites your text.
audio.param_help_pace: The overall tempo of the voice. Combines with Level, which controls articulation and linking.
audio.param_help_accent: The variety you hear (British, Canadian...). The text is still read in the script's language.
audio.param_help_accent_detail: Describe the accent freely: it fully replaces the preset. E.g. "Marseille accent", "German accent".
audio.param_help_style: The overall character of the voice, from tested presets. For a specific trait, add it in Manner of speaking.
audio.param_help_notes: Your free note to the voice actor: hesitations, emotion, confidence... Passed on as written.
audio.param_help_scene: The situation: place, moment, relationship. Sets the overall tone; never read aloud.
audio.guide_direction_1: Level or Pace? Pace sets the overall tempo; Level adapts the articulation: the lower it is, the slower, clearer, and less linked the reading. The text is never modified.
audio.guide_direction_2: Style or Manner of speaking? Style picks a tested character (examiner, host...). Manner of speaking adds your free notes: hesitates, almost whispers, very confident.
audio.guide_direction_3: Accent: pick a preset, or describe it freely in "Custom accent" — the free text then fully replaces the preset.
audio.guide_direction_4: In dialogue mode, each speaker has their own accent, style, and manner of speaking — useful for a native/learner pair or two different registers.
audio.guide_generation_1: Every take is generated directly at final quality: what you hear is exactly what your learners will hear.
audio.guide_generation_2: The estimate comes from the word count; your quota is charged on the actual generated duration, shown afterwards in the player (Estimated · actual).
audio.guide_generation_3: A long take is generated in blocks. In the player, click a block to regenerate only that one — only that block is charged.
audio.guide_generation_4: Audio files expire after 7 days; the script and settings stay in the history — "Duplicate" reloads them in one click.
audio.buy_intro: Purchased minutes never expire and top up your 60 included monthly minutes.

audio.checkout_success: Payment confirmed — your minutes will be credited in a few seconds.

context.title: Teaching context
context.body: Optional: add where/how you teach (school, private lessons, online, etc.). It helps the AI set better constraints.

save.title: Save your profile
